title: Temporary Deposit Interest Rate Relaxation Amended Directions (Multiple Bank Categories)
source_url: Not directly available from search results
description: <cite index="40-5,40-6">RBI issued six amendment directions on 25 August 2026 affecting Commercial Banks, Small Finance Banks, Local Area Banks, Regional Rural Banks, Urban Co-operative Banks and Rural Co-operative Banks, shortening the temporary relaxation on FCNR(B) and NRE deposit interest-rate restrictions from 30 September 2026 to 31 August 2026</cite>. While this is not directly related to lending recovery, it affects bank operations and liquidity management relevant to lenders.
